CWE-61.name: UNIX Symbolic Link (Symlink) Following
CWE-61.question: Does this function open or modify a file by path in a location others can write to, so a planted symbolic link could redirect it to another file?

any: a predictable path in /tmp, a shared or user-writable directory is opened, created, chown-ed or chmod-ed without refusing symbolic links
c: open(), fopen(), chmod() or chown() is used where O_NOFOLLOW, lchown, fchmod on an lstat-verified descriptor would be needed
python: open(), os.chmod() or shutil.copy() on such a path with no os.path.islink() / lstat check and no follow_symlinks=False

distinguish_from.CWE-377: the main defect is a predictable temporary file name rather than link handling

CWE-62.name: UNIX Hard Link

distinguish_from.CWE-65: the code path targets Windows hard links

CWE-66.name: Improper Handling of File Names that Identify Virtual Resources

CWE-178.name: Improper Handling of Case Sensitivity
CWE-178.question: Does this function compare a name, path, key or command case-sensitively to make an access or security decision when the resource it guards treats case as equal?

CWE-386.question: Does this function look up an object by a fixed name, path or identifier and then rely on it still naming the same object later, although it can be replaced in between?

CWE-706.name: Use of Incorrectly-Resolved Name or Reference
